app.name: Cofre
app.tagline: Your money, on your own infrastructure

mode.title: Where will your data live?
mode.subtitle: You can change later, by exporting and importing. Both answers are good, they are good for different things.
mode.browserBody: The database sits inside this browser. Nothing leaves it, no account is needed, and it works with no internet.
mode.browserCaveat: Only you, only here. Clearing site data erases everything.
mode.serverBody: The data lives on the server you keep, at home or on a rented machine. You sign in with email and password, from any device.
mode.serverCaveat: Needed to split bills with other people.
mode.serverAddressHint: The same address that shows up when you bring Cofre up with Docker.
mode.changeLater: Your choice is kept in this browser.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.signUpAction: Create the account and sign in
signIn.toSignUp: I do not have an account yet
signIn.signInFailed: The email or the password does not match.
signIn.signUpFailed: I could not create the account. That email may already be taken.
signIn.unreachable: I could not reach {{server}}. Check that the server is up and that the address is right.
signIn.useThisDevice: I would rather keep it on this device

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.headline: {{name}} invited you to the {{space}} space
invitation.needsServerBody: Invitations live on the server of whoever sent them. Connect this browser to a server and open the link again.
invitation.cannotOpenTitle: I could not open the invitation

reason.invitationUsed: This link was already used. Ask for another one.
reason.invitationExpired: This link has expired. Ask for another one.
reason.alreadyInside: You are already in that space.
reason.notFound: I could not find that invitation.

reports.nothingDetail: Pick another month, or write the first record.
reports.emptyBody: With no records there is nothing to add up. Write a few and come back.
reports.flowDescription: Diagram of the path the money took: {{income}} came in and {{expense}} went out, spread across the categories.
reports.categoryCaption: Spending by category in {{month}}, with amount and share
reports.biggest: {{name}} took {{amount}}, {{share}} per cent of everything that went out.
reports.priorityDetail: {{share}} per cent of what went out was desirable or superfluous.
reports.daysDescription: Map of the days of {{month}}, each one darker the more was spent.
reports.monthsDescription: Columns of money in and money out per month, side by side.
reports.monthsCaption: Money in, money out and the difference, month by month

shell.opening: Opening your database on this device.
shell.failedTitle: I could not open the database
shell.failedBody: This usually means the browser is blocking storage. Try leaving the private window, or allowing site data.
shell.notPersistentTitle: The data is only in memory
shell.notPersistentBody: This browser would not let anything be written to disk, so everything goes away when the tab closes. Fine for a look around, not for real use.
shell.busyTitle: Cofre is already open in another tab
shell.busyBody: In this mode the database is held by one tab at a time, so that no write is lost. Use the tab that is already open, or close it and try again here.

palette.title: What do you want to do?
palette.description: Find a screen, switch space, or run an action.

onboarding.title: Let us open your Cofre
onboarding.subtitle: Three fields and you are in. None of this leaves this device.
onboarding.name: What you are called
onboarding.emailHint: Optional. It links this profile to a server of yours, if one day you want to sync.
onboarding.currencyHint: Accounts in other currencies can come later.
onboarding.personalSpaceHint: This space is private and can never be shared with anyone.
onboarding.demoHint: Creates made up accounts and an example shared space, so you can see the product working. You can delete it afterwards.
onboarding.failedTitle: I could not create the profile

dashboard.headline: You have this much in {{space}}
dashboard.nothingPending: Nothing coming up moves that number for now.
dashboard.projectedDetail: Counting only what has already happened.
dashboard.oneSpaceOnly: This is the balance of this space. Switch at the top to see another.
dashboard.nothingDue: Nothing due in the next fifteen days.
dashboard.headlineEverywhere: This is what you have, every space added together

notice.budgetTight: {{name}} is tight: {{left}} left for the rest of the month.
notice.billLate: {{description}} fell due {{days}} days ago and is still open: {{amount}}.
notice.savingsBehind: {{missing}} short of your savings rule this month.

budget.noneYet: A limit turns a number into a decision.
budget.savingsExplain: The idea is simple: when money comes in, a part of it steps aside before any spending. Say how much and Cofre keeps track.
budget.savingsDescription: How much steps aside every time money comes in.
budget.ruleAccountHint: The account the saved money sits in, so Cofre can tell whether it went.
budget.ruleIsPercent: The rule is to save {{percent}} percent of what comes in.
budget.savingsBehind: Still short of the rule this month.
budget.goalsExplain: A goal points at the account its money sits in. What you saved is the balance of that account, so there is nothing to tick off by hand.
budget.newGoalDescription: What you want to put together, how much, and where that money sits.
budget.goalDateHint: Optional. With a date, Cofre says how much a month.
budget.goalAccountHint: One account holds one goal at a time, otherwise the same money would count twice.
budget.goalNeeds: {{amount}} a month to arrive on time.
budget.newLimitDescription: A limit holds every month until you change it.
budget.amountHint: Use a comma for the cents.
budget.stateTight: At this rate the month closes at {{amount}}.
budget.stateComfortable: {{amount}} left for the rest of the month.
budget.emptyBody: Start with what usually gets away from you, such as delivery or going out. One limit on one category already changes a month.

sharing.title: Who owes whom
sharing.explain: Add up what was divided and take away what was already settled. Settling is not a record: it changes who is holding the bill, not what the house spent.
sharing.splitDescription: How {{description}} is divided between the people of the space.
sharing.sharesHint: Two and one means two thirds and one third.
sharing.incomeHint: Everybody pays in proportion to what they earn. Whoever has not said what they earn can fill it in under Members.
sharing.paidByHint: Whoever put the money in, which is not always who wrote it down.

accounts.title: Accounts in {{space}}
accounts.createDescription: The account goes into the {{space}} space.
accounts.caption: Accounts of the {{space}} space, with name, kind, institution and balance
accounts.name: Name
accounts.balanceHint: How much is in this account today. Use a comma for the cents.
accounts.closingDayHint: A purchase on that day or after goes on the next invoice.
accounts.dueDayHint: When the invoice has to be paid.
accounts.emptyBody: Start with the account your salary lands in. Cards, cash and investments can come later.

rules.emailTaken: There is already a profile with that email on this device. Use another one.
rules.emailLooksWrong: That does not look like an email address.
rules.onePersonalSpace: You already have a personal space.
rules.accountIsArchived: That account is archived. Bring it back before writing to it.
rules.amountIsPositiveInteger: Write an amount greater than zero.
rules.transferNeedsDestination: Pick the account the money lands in.
rules.transferNeedsTwoAccounts: A transfer needs two different accounts.
rules.reconciledIsFrozen: That record was checked against the bank. Undo the check before changing it.
rules.categoryDepthIsTwo: A category goes inside another one and stops there. Pick one that stands on its own.
rules.categoryHasChildren: That category has others inside it. Move or delete those first.
rules.categoryIsNotItsOwnParent: A category cannot sit inside itself.
rules.categoriesAlreadyThere: This space already has categories, so the starting set was not written again.
rules.matchTextIsTooShort: Write at least two letters, otherwise the rule catches everything.
rules.recurrenceNeedsOneCurrency: A recurrence uses the currency of the space. Pick an account in it.
rules.budgetNeedsCategory: Pick the category the limit is on.
rules.budgetNeedsPriority: Pick the priority the limit is on.
rules.monthIsNotAMonth: Write the month as a year and a month.
rules.accountAlreadyHasGoal: That account already holds a goal. Use another account, or delete the goal that is there.
rules.percentIsTooLarge: There is no saving more than what comes in.
rules.splitNeedsPeople: There is nobody to divide this with: this space has one person in it.
rules.splitNeedsMembers: Somebody in this division does not belong to the space.
rules.splitNeedsShares: The shares add up to zero. Give at least one person a share.
rules.splitNeedsIncome: Nobody has said what they earn. Fill it in under Members to divide by income.
rules.onlyExpensesAreSplit: Only an expense is divided, because only an expense is a cost.
rules.payerIsNotAMember: Whoever paid has to belong to the space.
rules.unknown: I could not finish that. Try again.

transactions.title: Records in {{space}}
transactions.caption: Records of the {{space}} space, with day, description, account and amount
transactions.createDescription: Say what happened. The sign comes from the kind, so you always type a positive number.
transactions.installmentsHint: Each part lands on the right invoice of the card.
transactions.plannedHint: Counted in what is coming, and left out of the balance until you mark it as paid.
transactions.emptyBody: Change the month, or write the first record. It takes a few seconds.
transactions.amountMissing: Write an amount greater than zero.
transactions.noCategoriesYet: No categories yet. Create them in Categories.
transactions.priorityHint: Pick a category and the priority comes from it.
transactions.priorityFromCategory: The category says {{priority}}. Change it only when this one is different.
transactions.taught: Done. Every record with {{text}} in the description goes to that category.

rulesSection.title: Rules that sort on their own
rulesSection.explain: When a record arrives with no category, the first rule that matches decides for it. What you chose by hand is never replaced by a rule.
rulesSection.createDescription: Write a piece of what shows up in the description and say where it goes.
rulesSection.sorted_one: Sorted {{count}} record that had no category.
rulesSection.sorted_other: Sorted {{count}} records that had no category.
rulesSection.sorted_zero: Nothing to sort: everything already has a category.
rulesSection.sentence: When it has {{text}}, it goes to {{category}}
rulesSection.matchTextHint: Case and accents are ignored. A piece is enough, such as ifood or uber.
rulesSection.empty: No rules yet. Sort one record and use its menu to write the first one.

recurrences.title: What happens again
recurrences.explain: Rent, a subscription, a salary. Cofre writes these as planned records on the right days, and they only touch the balance when you mark them as paid.
recurrences.createDescription: Say what repeats, how much and from when.
recurrences.startsOnHint: The day of this date is the day that repeats.

calendar.headline: {{month}}, the way it will happen
calendar.nothingPending: Nothing planned is left this month.
calendar.plannedLegend: What is in another colour has not happened yet.

categories.title: Categories of {{space}}
categories.createDescription: Categories sort the spending. The priority says how much it was needed.
categories.name: Name
categories.priorityHint: A starting point. Any record can disagree when it makes sense.
categories.parentHint: Two levels at most, so a subcategory takes none of its own.
categories.noParent: None, it stands on its own
categories.emptyBody: Start from the set that covers what most people spend on, then make it yours. Rename, delete and add as many as you like.

quick.label: Quick record
quick.hint: Write it in one line: what it was, how much, when and where. It reads today, yesterday, 15/09, 3x and the name of the account.

savedFilters.keepDescription: It is kept with the space and shows up on any device of yours. Nobody else sees it.
savedFilters.name: Name

invoice.noCardTitle: No credit card in this space
invoice.noCardBody: Add the card with the day it closes and the day it falls due. From then on every purchase lands on the right invoice, including the ones split into parts.
invoice.noCycleBody: Without the closing day and the due day there is no way to say which invoice a purchase belongs to.
invoice.closedHeadline_one: The {{month}} invoice is closed and falls due tomorrow
invoice.closedHeadline_other: The {{month}} invoice is closed and falls due in {{count}} days
invoice.pastHeadline_other: The {{month}} invoice fell due {{count}} days ago
invoice.caption: Purchases on the card {{card}} in the {{month}} invoice, with day, description and amount

spaces.title: Your spaces
spaces.explain: Each space holds one slice of your money life. The personal one is yours alone. A shared space has members, roles and expense splitting.
spaces.createDescription: A shared space, for splitting bills with other people.
spaces.name: Name of the space
spaces.colourHint: The colour shows in the top bar, so you always know where you are writing.

members.title: Who is in {{space}}
members.caption: Members of the {{space}} space, with role and state
members.incomeDescription: Used only to divide expenses in proportion to what each person earns. Leave it empty not to use it.
members.incomeHint: Nobody sees this number outside this screen, and it shows up in no report.
members.inviteDescription: The person joins the {{space}} space once they open the link and accept.
members.linkReady: Done. Send this link to whoever you want in the space.
members.linkRules: Good for seven days, and for one person.
members.aloneBody: Invite whoever splits these bills with you. What each person sees comes from the role they get.
members.personalBody: This space is yours alone and takes no members. To split bills, create a shared space.
members.needsServerBody: In this mode the data sits in this browser alone, so there is nowhere for an invitation to point. With a server of yours, you make a link and the person comes in through it.

roleHint.admin: Does everything, except deleting the space or transferring it.
roleHint.editor: Writes and edits transactions, accounts, goals and budgets.
roleHint.logger: Only records expenses and sees their own. Meant for a child, or for whoever helps with the house.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.subtitle: Direction Papel e tinta. Every piece here is the piece that ships.
designSystem.colourNote: Contrast measured against the background of the active theme, with the WCAG formula. Text needs at least 4.5.
designSystem.specimenTitle: What is left until the end of the month
designSystem.specimenBody: Interface text in IBM Plex Sans, at the standard reading size.
designSystem.specimenSupport: Supporting text, in graphite, for labels and short explanations.

fields.amountHint: Use a comma for the cents.
fields.amountError: I could not read that amount. Write something like 42,90.

table.caption: Bills due in the next days, with date, description, category and amount

insight.headline: Groceries are up 18 percent since March
insight.detail: September came to 1,240.00 against an average of 1,050.00 over the six months before.

data.title: Data
data.explain: Everything here is yours. This screen takes it out, brings it back and syncs it, and every button says where the data goes.
data.importBody: Read a file from the bank in CSV, OFX, QIF, XLSX or JSON. You check everything before anything is written.
data.exportBody: The JSON backup carries a whole space and comes back in any other installation. The records file opens straight in a spreadsheet.
data.restoreBody: Pick a backup written by Cofre. Rows keep their identifiers, so opening the same file twice duplicates nothing.

skipped.unknownPerson_one: 1 row in {{table}} pointed at somebody this database does not know and was left out.
skipped.unknownPerson_other: {{count}} rows in {{table}} pointed at somebody this database does not know and were left out.

data.syncTitle: Sync with a server of yours
data.syncBody: The data stays in this browser. When you say so, it meets your server and the two start to agree.
data.serverHint: The same address you would use to open Cofre on the server.
data.syncRefused_one: 1 change was not accepted, because somebody else wrote it.
data.syncRefused_other: {{count}} changes were not accepted, because somebody else wrote them.
data.syncNotYours: The server did not let you into that space. Either it belongs to somebody else there, or you signed in with another account.
data.syncProfileTaken: The profile of this browser carries the same identifier as an account on the server, so it cannot write in that name.

importing.title: Import a statement
importing.explain: Pick the file, check what Cofre understood, and only then write it down. Nothing is written before that.
importing.pickHint: CSV, OFX, QIF, XLSX or a JSON backup. The file does not leave this device.
importing.accountHint: The whole file goes into this account.
importing.columnsHint: If a column was read as the wrong thing, correct it here and the list below follows.
importing.duplicatesTitle_one: 1 looks like it is already here
importing.duplicatesTitle_other: {{count}} look like they are already here
importing.duplicatesBody: When the bank gave the same identifier the record comes unticked and locked. When only the day, the amount and the start of the description match, it is yours to decide.
importing.caption: Records read from the file, with date, description, amount and whether they are already here
importing.emptyTitle: I found no records in this file
importing.emptyBody: Check that this is the right statement, or correct the columns above.
importing.unreadable: I could not read this file. It may have arrived incomplete, or it may not be a statement.
importing.skippedTitle_one: See the line that was left out
importing.skippedTitle_other: See the {{count}} lines that were left out
importing.doneBody_one: It is in the space that is open, already sorted by your category rules.
importing.doneBody_other: They are in the space that is open, already sorted by your category rules.
importing.noAccountBody: A statement needs an account to go into. Create one under Accounts and come back.

demo.notice: Made up data, for demonstration only.
